preconditions.description: The number of rows r and columns c must be between 1 and 500.

postconditions.expression: if r == 1 and c == 1 then return_value == '0' else True
postconditions.description: If the matrix is 1x1, output 0 because no diverse matrix exists.

postconditions.expression: if r > 1 or c > 1 then len(return_value.splitlines()) == r and all(len(line.split()) == c for line in return_value.splitlines()) else True
postconditions.description: If the matrix is larger than 1x1, the output must contain r lines, each with c space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression:
all(1 <= int(num) <= 10**9 for num in return_value.replace(' ', '
').split())
postconditions.description: All elements in the matrix must be between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: b = [gcd(*map(int, line.split())) for line in return_value.splitlines()] + [gcd(*[int(row.split()[j]) for row in return_value.splitlines()]) for j in range(c)]
postconditions.description: Construct the array b from the matrix.
All elements in b must be pairwise distinct.

postconditions.expression: max(b) == min(max(b) for _ in range(1000) if (b := [gcd(*map(int, line.split())) for line in return_value.splitlines()] + [gcd(*[int(row.split()[j]) for row in return_value.splitlines()]) for j in range(c)]) and len(set(b)) == r + c)
postconditions.description: The magnitude of the matrix must be minimized.
